RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, July 27, 2018/Shravana 5, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 15
Prime Minister's package for farmers
of Bihar
*106. PROF. MANOJ KUMAR
JHA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Prime
Minister had, on 18 August, 2015
announced a package of  ` 3094 crore for
the welfare of farmers of Bihar; and
(b) if so, the amount of funds released
so far out of the said package?
Data on average monthly/annual
income of farmers
*107. SHRI MD. NADIMUL
HAQUE:  Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any National or
State level data on the average monthly/
annual income of a farmer in the country,
if so, the details thereof;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the methodology used to calculate
the average income of a farmer and how a
farmer is defined?
Installation of CCTV cameras at
railway stations and in trains
*108. SHRI KANAKAMEDALA
RA VINDRA KUMAR: Will the Minister
of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is finding it difficult to fund its project of
installing CCTV cameras at railway stations
and in certain trains;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any proposal is pending
with the Government to raise funds from
various funds, including the Nirbhaya Fund,
for funding the aforesaid project; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

39
Sharp decline in digital
transactions
†*109. CH. SUKHRAM SINGH
YADAV: Will the Minister of
ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a sharp decline
is being recorded in digital transactions
which happened during the demonetisation;
(b) the percentage of digital transactions
during the demonetisation and the
percentage of digital transactions at present;
(c) the details of the steps taken by
Government to enhance digital transactions
and whether there has been any positive
impact of the same; and
(d) the present status thereof?
Depleting fish stocks in Godavari
river
*110. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Inland Fisheries
Research Institute in West Bengal has
received a Notice from the National Green
Tribunal (NGT) on the petition of Godavari
river fishermen in Andhra Pradesh that fish
stocks have severely depleted;
(b) the details of the petition related to
destruction of fish seed by rampant sand
mining and water diversion on Godavari
river;
(c) whether a meeting has been organised
with the affected fishermen of riverine
villages of Gutala, Tadipudi and
Dowlaiswaram on river Godavari; and
(d) the steps proposed by Government
to address the issue?
Pending cases in courts
*111. MAHANT SHAMBHU-
PRASADJI TUNDIYA: Will the Minister
of  LAW AND JUSTICE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has any data
of the pending cases, including criminal
cases, in the courts across the country;
(b) if  so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the details of the plan for fast-
tracking work in judicial courts?
Law Commission report on regulation
of gambling in sports
*112. SHRIMATI VIJILA
SATHY ANANTH: Will the Minister of
LAW AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Law
Commission has submitted a report to the
Government proposing that since it is
impossible to stop illegal gambling, the only
viable option left is to regulate gambling in
sports;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Panel
wants the Government to introduce a cap
on the number of gambling transactions for
each individual; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Demand and supply of Data Scientists
*113. DR. KANW AR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of  ELECTRONICS  AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a huge mismatch
between the demand and supply of Data
Scientists in the country;
(b) if so, the extent of this gap and the
reasons therefor; and

Government to fill this gap?
Decline in new pharma product
launches

(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Pharma Industry has witnessed a decline
in new product launches, from 3505 pharma
product brands in 2011 to 3150 in 2018;
(b) if  so, whether their impact on
growth and contribution to the Indian
pharma market has also reduced over the
last 7-8 years; and
(c) whether it has come to
Government's notice that decline is due to

RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, July 27, 2018/Shravana 5, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Coal; Communications; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Electronics and Information Technology; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Parliamentary Affairs; Railways)
Total number of questions — 160
Scheme to promote animal
husbandry
1121. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has launched
any special scheme to promote animal
husbandry amongst farmers to earn
additional income which is likely to utilise
crop residue and also produce organic
manure for use in agricultural activities to
increase productivity;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of technical and financial
assistance extended to farmers for
domestication of cows, buffaloes, sheep
and goats in Maharashtra, district-wise?
Increase in MSP for Kharif crops
†1122. DR. SATYANARAYAN
JATIY A:
SHRI PRABHAT JAHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Central Government has
recently decided to increase the Minimum
Support Price (MSP) for 14 Kharif crops,
including paddy, by one and a half times
more than the cost of these crops;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this decision is a necessary
step towards achieving the target of doubling
the income of farmers by the year 2022; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Drought in Andhra Pradesh
1123. SHRI V. VIJAYASAI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Team recently
visited drought-affected Prakasam, Nellore,
Kadapa, Anantapur and Vizianagaram
districts of Andhra Pradesh and assessed
the damage caused due to drought conditions;
(b) whether the Central Team has
recognized serious drought conditions,
particularly in Prakasam district;
(c) the details of mandals and other
districts declared as drought-hit;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

263
(d) if so, the details of  report submitted
by the Central Team and the action taken
thereon; and
(e) the amount of financial assistance
sought by the Government of Andhra
Pradesh and the amount released by the
Central Government so far?
Production of pulses
1124. SHRI ANUBHA V MOHANTY:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the soaring prices of pulses
during 2016 resulted in the increase of
acreage on the back of incentivized by a
higher Minimum Support Price (MSP) with
technical intervention to ensure higher
domestic production;
(b) whether there was any
understanding between the Government
and the farmers who were switching over
to the production of pulses to boost the
yield to meet the domestic needs, to take
care of the excess production, if any; and
(c) if so, whether any effort has been
made by the farmers' consortium to restrict
the import of pulses from abroad?
Effects of use of excessive chemicals
and fertilisers on farmers' health
1125. SHRI ANUBHA V MOHANTY:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that effects on
farmers' health, due to use of excessive
chemical and fertilisers on their farm is on
the rise to an alarming state;
(b) whether Government would
consider imposing restriction on the sale of
chemicals and fertilisers, as it is harming
not only the farmer, the produces and the
field but also the end user; and
(c) the measure Government would
suggest to educate the farmers of the adverse
effects of the pesticides?
Storage of Agricultural produces
1126. SHRI M. P. VEERENDRA
KUMAR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the post-harvest storage of
agricultural produces is a big problem for
the farmers with the increase in production
of foodgrains in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
corrective steps taken by the Government
to prevent damage to foodgrains due to
natural calamites such as floods, drought
and frost?
Budgetary provision for women
farmers
†1127. SHRI NARAYAN RANE: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND
FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal to make budgetary provisions to
fulfil special needs of women farmers and
for attaining socio-economic and technical
empowerment, if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government has taken any
steps to ensure 30 per cent flow of funds
for women farmers under all the sponsored
schemes of the Central Government for
development of Agriculture sector, if so,
the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government has conducted
any study regarding participation and
contribution of women in agriculture, in
the country, if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
